findings.title: Bootstrap Candidate Review GO incorrectly requires final commit approval
findings.affected_control: Production Gate calculation and separation of Bootstrap Candidate Review from Bootstrap Human Commit
findings.exact_failure_condition: A structurally valid L3 bootstrap Task has an exact valid candidate and scanner record, exact actor-bound scope, all required evidence PASS, all required formal Reviews PASS, no blockers or open conditions, scope/execution approvals approved, and review_completion approved, while the human-exclusive final_commit_approval and top-level approval status correctly remain pending. validateTask adds 'L3 final commit approval is not approved.' to the shared gateReasons and assigns the resulting calculatedGate to gateResults.bootstrap_candidate_review. The declared production fixture reproduces NO-GO with that sole reason; it obtains candidate-review GO only after changing final_commit_approval and the top-level approval status to approved.

reproducible_read_only_check.expected_observation: PROD-01 is structural VALID/NO-GO with gate_reasons exactly including L3 final commit approval is not approved; source lines 245-252 then approve final_commit_approval before PROD-19 expects bootstrap_candidate_review=GO.

findings.impact: The production consumer cannot represent a completed clean Bootstrap Candidate Review while the separate human commit decision remains pending. It either leaves the candidate review Gate incorrectly NO-GO or pressures the workflow to record premature final commit approval merely to clear the earlier Gate. The later commit and steady-state outputs remain hard-coded NO-GO, so this is a gate-integrity and sequencing blocker rather than an unauthorized commit execution path.
